statute_opened.text_retrieved_by: search fetch of the same URL
statute_opened.amendment: Elections Law section 57(ט)(1) is changed from the 47th day to the 49th day before election day. Section 57(ט)(3) changes from the 52nd day to the 55th day. The PDF text does not print a clock time or a September date.

events.derived_if_election_day_is_2026_10_27: The 49th day before 27 October 2026 is 8 September 2026. That derivation is not a date printed in the statute. The old calendar date 2026-09-09 does not match a 49-day count.

The Petek schema.org text, opened, says the election is 27 October 2026. That site is an aggregator.
N12 articles in this window speak of the election being two weeks away, which matches this date, but the opened poll article does not print 27 October.

news_source.what_it_says: CEC chair Noam Sohlberg ruled that day that, if the 25th Knesset serves out its term, the next election is 27 October 2026, 16 Heshvan 5787, four years and ten days after the 1 November 2022 election. He cited Basic Law: The Knesset section 8 as the reason not to stretch the term to about five years.
